name: Isshiki Yasuhiro
source:
A young man who had previously been mistakenly arrested for a certain incident two years ago. At that point he was the lead singer of an indie rock group that was about to make their mainstream debut, but the mistaken arrest caused the band to break up. He's currently performing as a solo artist.

[From the [url=http://www.aksysgames.com/malice/characters/]official English website[/url]]
